FX-WS-001.says: As added: Smooth Motion at Smoothness 50, Position, Scale, Rotation, Stabilize, Crop, Auto-scale, on the card shaken about a steady pan. Frames 0 and 5 are the layer's ends, where the window closes to nothing, so they are as drawn; frames 2 and 3 are steadied and scaled up past their moving edges.

FX-WS-002.says: Stabilize Only: steadied, the edges the shake uncovers left clear.

FX-WS-003.says: Stabilize, Crop: steadied, cut to the largest middle rectangle the shake never uncovers, not scaled.

FX-WS-004.says: Method Position, Stabilize Only: moves only.

FX-WS-005.says: The card also turned a little each frame, Position, Scale, Rotation, Stabilize Only.

FX-WS-006.says: The turned card, Perspective, Stabilize Only.

FX-WS-007.says: The turned card, Preserve Scale on, Stabilize Only.

FX-WS-008.says: No Motion, Stabilize Only: every frame held to the layer's first, the pan taken out too.

FX-WS-009.says: Smoothness 0: the window is one frame, the layer exactly as it is.

FX-WS-010.says: Smoothness 8: one frame either side, where 50 reaches as far as the layer allows, two at frame 2.

FX-WS-011.says: Maximum Scale 101: the scale stops short, and the cut edges show clear.

FX-WS-012.says: Action-Safe Margin 10: scaled less, since a tenth of each side may stay cut.

FX-WS-014.says: Additional Scale keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 140 at frame 4: 120 at frame 2.

FX-WS-015.says: Detailed Analysis on: the motion found with a vector for every pixel.

FX-WS-016.says: Pixel Motion Blur's disc running steadily over nothing, Stabilize Only: only its own pixels count, and a steady run is left nearly as it is.

FX-WS-017.says: An Exposure of +1 before Warp Stabilizer: the frames it reads are brightened too.

FX-WS-018.says: An Exposure of -1 after Warp Stabilizer darkens its picture.

FX-WS-019.says: The holder moved 3 right and 2 down: FX-WS-002 moved.

FX-WS-020.says: The layer's in point at frame 2: frame 2 is its first, as drawn; frame 3 has one frame either side.

FX-WS-021.says: The effect on an adjustment layer above the holder: nothing changes, and the frame says why.

FX-WS-022.says: The shaken card on twos: the frames that repeat a drawing add no motion.
